missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Беседа' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the predicate. 'Приятная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'была' agrees in gender.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Беседу' is the accusative direct object of 'продолжили'. 'Нашу' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after после. 'Беседы' takes the genitive after 'после' to mark the time afterward. 'Он ушёл домой' completes the scene.

missions.phrase: Он готовился к беседе с директором.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Беседе' is the dative form after 'к', marking what he prepared for. 'С директором' names the other party.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of object. 'Беседой' is the instrumental form governed by 'доволен'. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Беседе' takes the prepositional form after 'в' to mean taking part in the conversation. 'Все коллеги' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Беседы' is the genitive form expressing the topic of the conversation. 'Тема' is the nominative subject, and 'серьёзной' is instrumental after 'была'.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Беседы' is genitive singular required by 'две'. The possession frame 'у нас было' introduces the count.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Беседы' is the accusative plural object of 'провели'. 'Долгие' agrees in the plural, describing the lengthy talks.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after после. 'Бесед' is the genitive plural required by 'после'. 'Таких' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'всем легче' gives the result.
